records.title: VLM-guided retrieval augmented generation (RAG) for robot action prediction
records.reason: Primary abstract applies VLM retrieval to robot action prediction and does not claim an LLM/VLM inference-efficiency improvement.

records.title: XTC: Head-Aware Sampling by Excluding Top Choices
records.reason: Primary abstract changes autoregressive sampling to improve output diversity; it gives no inference-cost, memory, latency, or throughput benefit.

records.title: Don't Repeat Yourself: Stopping Verbatim Loops at Sampling Time
records.reason: Primary abstract addresses repetitive-text quality failures at sampling time; it does not present or evaluate an inference-efficiency improvement.

records.title: SAVER: Selective Auditing of Verbal Evidence for Error Recovery in VLM Change Reasoning
records.reason: Primary abstract studies evidence selection for VLM visual-change reasoning and output reliability, not inference efficiency.

records.title: Buried in Textual Debt: Context Pruning with Visual Evidence Preservation for MLLM Agents
records.reason: The pipeline adds summary/reconstruction and a separately fine-tuned summarizer; end-to-end inference compute/latency including those calls is not established, so token reduction alone leaves efficiency unclear.
